name: Full Remote Work Transition
description: The company is planning to migrate from primarily office-based work to 100% remote work within 3 months. This requires changes to collaboration practices, communication protocols, and company culture. Existing office lease is significant but can be terminated. Customer contracts don't explicitly prohibit remote work but some legacy clients value in-person relationships.
context: Post-pandemic shift. Market is competitive for talent. Some employees have relocated, others prefer office. Technology infrastructure is partially remote-ready.
